articles.title: Anthony Gordon Found Respect At Barcelona, Not Just In England
articles.summary: Anthony Gordon left the Premier League for Barcelona to get 'respect' and he finally got it. See why the move to Spain was the right call for the winger.
articles.body:
Anthony Gordon left the Premier League for Barcelona to get 'respect,' and he's got it now . This summer, the 25-year-old English winger arrived from Newcastle United with an initial fee north of €70 million and instantly made an impact. He is already a key part of coach Hansi Flick's attack alongside Lamine Yamal and Raphinha. It looks like he finally found the home he needed to really show his talent.

Gordon never stopped believing he was meant for the top level, even through the hard times. His boyhood club Everton saw him fight relegation, while a 2021 loan spell took him to Preston North End. He also dealt with scoreless streaks after moving to Newcastle in 2023. But he never lost faith in his own ability to succeed at the highest level.

Earlier this season, Gordon spoke about people in England starting to respect " the quality and IQ that I play with ." His comments were seen as a sign he had not always gotten the recognition he deserved back home. He told ESPN that he did not mean that people were judging him unfairly or that they had a negative view of him. He simply meant they had never seen him in a system that highlights these qualities before.

People hadn't seen him in this kind of system before, which he thinks is helping them appreciate him more. The move to Spain seems to have unlocked a side of his game that the Premier League could not show. Maxime Estève, a defender now at RB Leipzig, told ESPN that Gordon is really good and sharp with a great right foot. Estève said Gordon is great at one-on-ones and wants to beat the right back every time.

Was departing the Premier League necessary for him to achieve this? It seems the answer is yes for Gordon. The English game often demands a certain type of physical play that can hide a player's true brain and skill set. Barcelona offers a different kind of football that lets his IQ shine through on the field. Now a regular starter, he kicked off Tuesday's UEFA Champions League victory over Aston Villa.

Gordon and Barcelona will kick off their LaLiga clash against Atlético Madrid this Sunday at the top of the table. The fans in England might have missed out on seeing his full potential for a few more years. Now they get to watch him thrive on one of the biggest stages in world soccer. The respect he wanted is now being given to him in spades by the Spanish league.

articles.title: Nick Saban Takes Subtle Shot at Marcus Freeman’s Notre Dame After Spotting Major Flaw Against BYU
articles.summary: Notre Dame has won seven of its first eight games, and its defense has given opponents very little room to work with. But the Fighting Irish still have one q...
articles.body:
Notre Dame has won seven of its first eight games, and its defense has given opponents very little room to work with. But the Fighting Irish still have one question to answer before the biggest game of their season: can their offense keep up when the competition gets tougher? Their loss to BYU brought that concern into focus, and with Miami coming to South Bend, the spotlight is now on Marcus Freeman's team.

The Irish are ranked No. 11 in the first College Football Playoff rankings and know that Saturday's meeting with the No. 1 Hurricanes could shape their chances of making the field. Former Alabama head coach Nick Saban has been watching the team closely, and one part of Notre Dame's performance against BYU clearly stood out to him.

"Notre Dame hasn't been able to put it together in big games," Saban said. "They got guys wide (expletive) open in the BYU game and hell, I can throw it to them. If a guy is open by 10 yards, you don't have to make a perfect pass. Just get the ball to them," Writer John Leuzzi posted on X on 7 November.

Saban was pointing to the chances Notre Dame missed during its October 17 loss to BYU. The Irish went into halftime trailing 21-10 and never managed to turn things around. Quarterback CJ Carr completed 27 of 49 passes for 261 yards, finishing with a 55.1% completion rate and no passing touchdowns.

It was his lowest completion percentage of the season, and the missed throws became a concern heading into the Miami game.

To be fair, Saban did have plenty of praise for Notre Dame. The Irish defense is allowing just 236.3 yards per game, the fewest in the country. It is also tied for fourth nationally in scoring defense, giving up 13.4 points per game.

Notre Dame's next game could make a major difference in its playoff hopes. At 7-1 and sitting at No. 11, the Irish have not yet picked up a win over a ranked opponent. With no other ranked teams remaining on their schedule after Miami, Saturday's matchup gives them a chance to add the kind of win the selection committee wants to see.

Saban made his feelings clear during an appearance on The Pat McAfee Show, calling the game a must-win for Freeman's team.

"This is a huge game. Obviously, playing the No. 1 team in the country at home. I think the game is kind of a must-win situation, because the College Football Playoff put them conveniently at No. 11. 'Conveniently' means if they don't win, they may be on the outside looking in. Not saying they can't play their way back into it, but they don't have the strongest schedule to finish with."

Saban also made sure to point out that he likes Notre Dame's defense and Freeman's approach. Still, he believes the Irish need a quality win to strengthen their playoff case.

Miami enters the game as the No. 1 team in the CFP rankings. The Hurricanes are also expected to be without star wide receiver Malachi Toney, who is dealing with an ankle injury that will require a medical procedure and keep him out for an extended period.

Notre Dame was not the only topic Saban discussed during his appearance on the New Heights podcast with Jason and Travis Kelce. He also spoke about the planned expansion of the College Football Playoff from 12 teams to 24, which is expected to begin in 2027.

"There's not 24 teams in the country that can win the National Championship," Saban said.

He questioned why college football needs such a large playoff field and suggested that money is a major reason behind the proposed change.

"Playing in the SEC Championship was a big thing to our players, it was a big thing to our fans, it was a tradition, and it was a great venue," he said. "There's a lot of pride in winning the conference championship. And we're going to give that up to have an extra game, where the 24th team is going to play the ninth-best team. I'm not a big (proponent) of it."

Saban also questioned whether the additional playoff round would bring in enough money to make up for the revenue lost from conference championship games. While he has suggested that a 16-team format could be a middle ground, he is not convinced that 24 teams are needed.

For now, Notre Dame has a more immediate challenge to deal with. Freeman's team has the defense to compete with the country's top programs, but the game against Miami will give its offense a chance to show it can deliver when the pressure is on. A win would give the Irish the signature result they have been missing. A loss could leave their playoff hopes in a much tougher position.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes Vows to Do ‘Whatever It Takes’ to End Chiefs Slump Despite Serious Injury Risk
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes and the Kansas City Chiefs are facing a rare regular-season crisis. After a dominant 5-0 start to the year, back-to-back losses to the Seattl...
articles.body:
Patrick Mahomes and the Kansas City Chiefs are facing a rare regular-season crisis. After a dominant 5-0 start to the year, back-to-back losses to the Seattle Seahawks and Denver Broncos have left the Chiefs at 5-2. Sunday's 28-24 collapse at Empower Field at Mile High stung the deepest.

Kansas City held a commanding 24-13 lead early in the fourth quarter, only to watch the Broncos erupt for 15 unanswered points. The historic meltdown handed Patrick Mahomes just his third career loss when leading by double digits in the final frame.

Now, despite throwing for 321 yards and three touchdowns in the defeat, a frustrated Mahomes is publicly vowing to risk his own physical health to stop the skid this Sunday against the New York Jets.

Patrick Mahomes vows to run sneaks after Chiefs' goal-line collapse

The game came down to a brutal final 35 seconds that left Chiefs fans furious. Kansas City was down by four but had a first-and-goal at the Denver 4-yard line, giving them a 76% chance to win according to Next Gen Stats. On first down, Kenneth Walker III rushed to the 1-yard line. But the offense stalled from there, as Mahomes threw an incomplete pass on second down and Walker was stuffed for no gain on third down.

Following the goal-line collapse, the Chiefs community directed heavy criticism toward the team's refusal to run a quarterback sneak on either down from the 1-yard line.

Data shows that Kansas City is the single most hesitant team in the NFL when it comes to short-yardage under-center runs. According to Pro Football Focus, the Chiefs have attempted only eight total sneaks since 2019, with tight ends Blake Bell or Noah Gray lining up under center for every single one of them.

Mahomes addressed the hole in the offensive playbook, bluntly acknowledging his fearlessness. "I'm going to do whatever it takes to win," he said . "At the end of the day, quarterback sneak, whatever that is, I'll do whatever it takes. It's not like I'm scared to go out there and put my body on the line. That's kind of how I played. And it's gotten me in trouble sometimes, and then sometimes it's helped the team."

The "trouble" Mahomes referenced points directly back to October 17, 2019. During a Week 7 matchup against Denver, Mahomes dislocated his right kneecap on a fourth-and-1 sneak from the Broncos' 5-yard line.

While an MRI the following day revealed no structural damage, early team expectations feared a four-to-six-week recovery timeline. Mahomes defied the odds by missing only two games before making his return on Nov. 10 against the Tennessee Titans.

Andy Reid defended the play back then in 2019, but he hasn't allowed Mahomes to run a sneak since. That restriction could break this Sunday as the Chiefs try to end their losing streak. If Reid still wants to play it safe with Mahomes, he can turn to his bench. Backup quarterback Justin Fields is a great option to handle those short-yardage plays instead.

articles.title: El 'superventas' que arrasa después de que España conquistara el Mundial
articles.standfirst: La Copa del Mundo de Lego se ha convertido en una de las colecciones más vendidas de la marca tras el éxito de este verano
articles.summary: La Copa del Mundo de Lego se ha convertido en una de las colecciones más vendidas de la marca tras el éxito de este verano
articles.body: Entre los millones de cartas a los Reyes Magos, Papá Noel, Olentzero, Apalpador o Tió de Nadal seguro que se enconden mil sueños deportivos que sólo estos personajes pueden hacer realidad. Entre los materiales, los juguetes de toda vida, un Clásico con vigencia actual: la Copa del Mundo de LEGO. "Para nosotros ha sido toda una sorpresa. Confiábamos en poder trasladar la pasión del deporte a la pasión de la creatividad que se transmite a través de los ladrillos", explicó a MARCA Pilar Villela, Brand Director del Grupo LEGO para Francia e Iberia. "Ha sido un súper ventas y esperamos que sea uno de los regalos más demandados estas Navidades", añadió durante la jornada de puertas abiertas en el 'LEGO Home of Christmas'. La Copa del Mundo, a escala real, consta de 2.482 piezas. Se hizo una primera versión, en cuyo interior se esconde la figura de un niño que fue el encargado de anunciar el lanzamiento del producto el pasado mes de abril junto a Cristiano Ronaldo, Kylian Mbappé, Leo Messi y Vinicius Jr. Luego se hizo una edición especial para conmemorar la victoria de España, con una placa y la bandera de nuestro país, que además aparece en la nómina de ganadores que se puede observar en la base. "Ha supuesto todo un reto para los equipos de diseño porque trasladar algo tan dinámico como el deporte a algo estático como unos ladrillos tiene mucha complejidad, pero de ahí también la belleza del resultado final. Creo que ha conectado muy bien con los fans, que aprecian muchísimo el nivel de detalle", destacó Pilar. "Para nosotros ha supuesto explorar un territorio nuevo, ya que no éramos expertos, pero confiábamos mucho en que fuera un éxito como así ha sucedido. Al final lo que nos mueve es la pasión: por el deporte, la creatividad, la imaginación", subrayó. Además del trofeo, la colección de fútbol tiene otras piezas interesantes como el balón, las zapatillas o las botas de tacos, amén de cuatros sets con cuatro estrellas mundiales. La figura de Mbappé se coloca sobre empedrado en vez de césped, emulando las calles parisinas, rodeado de monumentos representativos de la ciudad como el Arco del Triunfo con las dos estrellas que son los dos Mundiales que tiene Francia. Cuentan desde LEGO que, amén de elegir las botas amarillas y calcetines rojos, el propio Kylian decidió junto a los diseñadores el pelo de su efigie. "Estamos muy contentos cómo se han resuelto las colaboraciones. Tanto con los jugadores, como con la FIFA u otras instituciones y marcas con las que colaboramos. Son figuras reconocibles a nivel global que hemos acercado a familias enteras, ya que son productos que consumen tanto mayores como pequeños", aseveró en MARCA Vincent Plane, Country Manager del Grupo LEGO Iberia. La figura de Cristano tiene un set especial en el que emular tanto su famosa chilena como la celebración tan característica (el 'Siuuuuu') que se ha hecho marca. Se juega con la bandera de Portugal y la isla de Madeira. En el caso de Messi la figura, que tiene dibujados con detalle hasta sus tatuajes, está celebrando con los dedos mirando al cielo y en el set se observan la camiseta de todos sus equipos (Newell's Old Boys, Central Córdoba, Barcelona, PSG e Inter de Miami). La de Vinicius simula Río de Janeiro como escenario, destacando las favelas y el pan de azúcar. Como curiosidad, que el brasileño sale sacando la lengua, detalle difícil de conseguir y que le gustó mucho al protagonista. "Lego es una buena herramienta para acercar a la gente la cultura popular y el fútbol forma parte de ella. Además, entendemos que la mayoría de colecciones son para todas las edades y que conllevan momentos en familia. Estamos contentos con la respuesta del usuario y seguiremos trabajando en esta dirección, tanto con el fútbol masculino como con el femenino", apunta Vincent, que recuerda que jugadoras como Alexia Putellas, Misa Rodríguez, Sam Kerr, Megan Rapinoe, Yuki Nagasato, Asisat Oshoala o Beth Mead han colaborado con la firma en diferentes campañas. Más allá del fútbol cabe destacar la colección de cascos y monoplazas de Fórmula 1. Y más allá del deporte, multitud de temáticas: videojuegos, amor al arte, aventuras y superhéroes, vehículos, actividades cotidianas, animales, calendarios de adviento... Más de 900 colecciones y más de 915 millones de combinaciones de los míticos ladrillos. Sin duda, una gran opción para los días que vienen. "Al 2027 le pedimos que Lego siga teniendo una trayectoria tan exitosa como hasta ahora, aportando creatividad, sociabilidad y ganas de jugar en familia", resuelve Plane. "El objetivo es descubrir, despertar el interés y que la familia de Lego sea cada vez mayor", añade Pilar.

articles.title: Sara Ortega busca ser de nuevo el azote del Real Madrid: "Sería un sueño repetirlo"
articles.standfirst: La riojana anotó el gol de la victoria ante las blancas en el último precedente ante el Athletic Club
articles.summary: La riojana anotó el gol de la victoria ante las blancas en el último precedente ante el Athletic Club
articles.body: El Athletic Club recibe este sábado (16:00 horas) al Real Madrid en Lezama. El último duelo entre ambos equipos, el del pasado 13 de enero en el Alfredo Di Stéfano, acabó con victoria rojiblanca por la mínima gracias a un gol de Sara Ortega. "Sería un sueño repetirlo otra vez", confiesa en MARCA la protagonista. "Es un partido muy importante y creemos que será competido. Venimos en una muy buena dinámica y el equipo seguramente lo haga notar. Jugamos en casa y queremos sumar tres puntos delante de nuestra afición", subraya. El Athletic Club llega a la cita tras caer (2-0) en el Heliodoro Rodríguez López ante el Costa Adeje Tenerife, un encuentro marcado por el percance, horas antes, que acabó posteriormente con la vida de Jesús de Miguel. "Cuando llegamos al estadio nos comunicaron que estaba estable en la UCI. Luego se dio la vuelta a la situación y acabó de la peor forma posible. Me gustaría mandar mucho ánimo a toda la familia y amigos", apunta Sara. "Desde el día siguiente que nos dieron la noticia no he parado de darle vueltas y es algo que hemos hablado mucho en el vestuario. Creo que fue un fatal accidente, pero claro que te hace pensar", añade. Las rojiblancas son quintas, con 15 puntos, a siete de distancia de las blancas, que son segundas. "Puede ser un partido para ver dónde estamos y a lo que podemos aspirar. Sea cual sea el resultado, creo que tenemos equipo para mirar hacia arriba y acabar lo más alto posible en la clasificación", asevera Sara. "No somos mucho de mirar en qué posición vamos, queda mucha temporada por delante, pero poder acabar en posiciones europeas es un objetivo ambicioso. Para mí sería un sueño jugar la Champions con el Athletic y ojalá podamos clasificarnos esta temporada", recalca. Aunque sigue siendo el tercer equipo con la media de edad más joven (24.9), las rojiblancas ya no son tan Baby Athletic. "Con experiencia, pero seguimos siendo jóvenes, ¿eh?", reivindica Sara. "Creo que estamos haciendo un fútbol que interesa mucho a la gente. Estamos consiguiendo tener mucha posesión, sacar el balón desde atrás y tener ritmo, intensidad y energía que nos está dando buenos resultados. Yo estoy muy contenta porque es un estilo de juego que se adapta muy bien a mis características y a como me gusta jugar", analiza. Ortega ha jugado ocho de los nueve partidos de su equipo este curso, partiendo los mismos encuentros desde el once titular como del banquillo, anotando un gol y repartido dos asistencias. "No tuve pretemporada porque estuve lesionada, pero estoy contenta de ir sumando minutos y aportar lo mejor de mí al equipo, ya sea como titular o como suplente. Ahora estoy al 100% y en disposición de aportar donde diga el entrenador", afirma. "Estamos todas muy contentas con Víctor (Martín). Él confía mucho en mí y lo que me pide es que sea atrevida y valiente y aporte lo máximo al equipo", destaca. Sara ha jugado 117 partidos con el Athletic Club, anotando nueve goles y siendo uno de los referentes actuales del equipo. Sus números, su calidad y su proyección hacen que llame a las puertas de la selección española absoluta. "Estoy currando mucho para sacar mi mejor versión. Para mí sería un sueño recibir esa llamada, pero estoy tranquila y centrada en mi trabajo para que se pueda dar esa oportunidad", cuenta este talento de 154 centímetros de altura que cuenta esta temporada con preparador físico y psicóloga al margen del club. "Me hizo mucha ilusión ver en la última convocatoria a Clara (Pinedo) y Adri (Nanclares) porque significa que estamos haciendo las cosas bien y ojalá en la siguiente estemos alguna más", declara. "Está claro que, habiendo Mundial en verano, la ilusión por estar ahí crece. Tanto Sonia (Bermúdez) como Iraia (Iturregi) me conocen bien, así que no tengo que decirle más que estoy lista", finiquita.

articles.title: Giménez: "Al Cholo le debo la vida, desde los 19 años he estado con él"
articles.standfirst: El central repasa en esta entrevista en MARCA cómo fue su salida del Atlético el último día del mercado de fichajes y cómo está viviendo sus primeros meses en el Deportivo, un club en el que le gustaría retirarse en España
articles.summary: El central repasa en esta entrevista en MARCA cómo fue su salida del Atlético el último día del mercado de fichajes y cómo está viviendo sus primeros meses en el Deportivo, un club en el que le gustaría retirarse en España
articles.body: José María Giménez ha encajado como un guante en el Deportivo. El carácter y la jerarquía del central se han notado desde el primer día. Ahora se sienta con MARCA para repasar su salida del Atlético, el club de su vida, y el nuevo desafío que afronta en Riazor. Pregunta. ¿Cuándo decide que el Dépor es el destino para continuar su carrera? Respuesta. Lo primero que uno hace cuando le plantean posibilidades es escuchar las propuestas, sobre todo, a nivel de proyecto futbolístico. A partir de ahí, valoro con la familia cuál es la mejor opción y, después, obviamente, el club que me transmita más seguridad, seriedad, más compromiso con lo que está haciendo... A mí me llama Fernando Soriano en la mañana del último día de mercado y luego un excompañero que jugó en el Dépor y en el Atlético, que me contó más o menos cómo es la ciudad y el club. Me transmitieron seguridad. Hablaba con un club con mucha seriedad. P. Buscaba un proyecto interesante… R. Nunca puse en la balanza el tema económico, era algo que no me preocupaba, simplemente quería dar un paso para ir a un equipo y ser feliz. Yo era muy feliz en el Atlético, pero dadas las circunstancias que estaba viviendo, quería ser feliz, quería disfrutar del fútbol y quería competir. Cuando me llama el Deportivo, sinceramente, lo vi como un desafío muy lindo para mí. P. Fue todo muy rápido el último día de mercado. R. Por la mañana del último día le mandé un mensaje a Fernando Soriano y le dije: “Elegí el Dépor”. Durante el día me llamaron varios clubes y yo dije que no quería escuchar más, ya me había decidido y soy un hombre de palabra. P. ¿Los clubes se pusieron rápido de acuerdo? R. El Atlético me ayudó. A ellos también les servía que yo saliera por el tema salarial. Al final habían fichado a otro central, al Cuti Romero, y estaba sobrepoblada la línea de centrales. P. ¿Cuándo habla con Simeone para saber que lo mejor es una salida? R. Yo hablé con el Cholo la temporada anterior, casi al final, y él me transmitió el pensamiento de cara a la siguiente campaña. Él siempre tuvo en cuenta que a mí me quedaban dos años más de contrato y que de alguna manera cada uno el contrato también se lo ganó, ¿no? Tuve la posibilidad de salir dos veces y las dos veces decidí quedarme en el Atlético con la certeza de que estaba haciendo lo correcto, no me equivoqué. Entendí lo que me transmitió el entrenador, entendí lo que necesitaba el club y tomé una decisión. Yo me podría haber quedado perfectamente en el Atlético, compitiendo y diciéndole al técnico: “Mira, yo me quiero quedar acá a competir”. Pero también podía quedarme en la zona de confort sólo por decir: “Estoy acá, cobro mi contrato...”. Yo quería ayudar al Atlético, porque el Atlético me ayudó un montón y seguramente nos vayamos a seguir ayudando. P. Simeone tuvo palabras muy bonitas sobre usted… R. Sí, son tantos años que el cariño está, además del profesional. A mí el Cholo me dio la vida, desde los 19 años he estado con él. Lo que soy y lo que tengo es gracias a que él me ayudó muchísimo. Crecí con él, aprendí con él y traté de devolverle todo lo que él me dio a base de trabajo, esfuerzo, sacrificio y siempre con humildad, haciendo las cosas mejor o peor, pero tratando de dar lo máximo de mí. P. ¿Se despidió de sus compañeros o no tuvo tiempo? R. Sí, fue muy complicado después de tantos años despedirme de Koke, de Oblak, jugadores con los que compartí casi toda la vida. Fue duro. Pero cuando te vas cedido, una parte de ti dice: “Bueno, en algún momento puedo volver”. Y creo que esa fue la sensación que me sucedió cuando me fui a despedir de ellos, antes de venir. P. Es una cesión pero con sabor a despedida… R. Yo tengo claro, y creo que todo el mundo, los hinchas, la directiva y mis compañeros, que no me toca volver al equipo. Eso lo fui descubriendo a medida que me instalaba en otro lugar. P. Usted es de desafíos. R. [Se ríe] Me conoces. Los desafíos me encantan. Si hay algo que me gusta es que sea difícil. Eso me motiva. Yo siento que tengo condiciones para competir y no me achico, pero la realidad es que el equipo, el club, creó una estructura y ya ves que no estás en los planes. Es una realidad. Hay que ser humilde y aceptarlo. A partir de ahí, mi humildad me dice que yo no tengo que volver ahí, por más que tenga dos años más de contrato. P. ¿Le gustaría retirarse en el Dépor? R. Sí, me gustaría, ¿por qué no? No sé cuántos años me quedan. Creo que aún estoy en una etapa buena a nivel físico y no sé cuándo bajaré, cuándo sentiré que el físico no me da o que necesito ir con más calma. A día de hoy me veo compitiendo unos años más. ¿Cuánto? No sé, eso lo dirá el tiempo. Sería bonito retirarme en España con el Dépor y después ir a Danubio, a ayudar al equipo. P. Lleva dos meses en A Coruña y ya ha sido capitán. R. Es un orgullo, una sensación hermosa. Desde que llegué, la gente no ha parado de mostrarme cariño. Y eso lo valoro. Trataré todo el tiempo que esté acá devolver ese cariño con trabajo, con dedicación y con compromiso. A Coruña es una ciudad hermosa. P. Un buen detalle de Yeremay… R. Yere es un capitán, un líder, aunque no lo vea todo el mundo. En lo futbolístico, él es nuestro mejor jugador, es la realidad. Es un crack. Pero a la hora de hablar se siente más… cohibido. Yo me puse la cinta, porque hablo mucho con el árbitro, siempre en buenos términos. Eso demuestra que somos una familia, también en el vestuario, y muestra la humildad y la grandeza de un tipo que está creciendo y que quiere seguir creciendo con el Dépor como Yeremay. P. Cada día Yeremay es más maduro en todos los sentidos. R. Estoy de acuerdo. Y eso que lo conozco desde hace poco. Pero el tipo decidió quedarse acá. Desechó ofertas de muchos millones de clubes grandes. Él quiso debutar en Primera con el Deportivo, es humilde y tiene grandeza, ojalá siga así porque no tiene techo. Hacía mucho tiempo que no veía a un chico con tantas cosas y con tanta calidad como Yeremay. P. Parece que usted lleva toda la vida en el Dépor… R. El Dépor es un club hermoso que nunca debió estar donde llegó a estar. Pero, a base de esfuerzo, de sacrificio y de responsabilidad, está de vuelta donde mereció siempre estar. Ahora lo que toca es acompañar, trabajar y seguir creciendo como grupo, como equipo, y estar unidos con los hinchas, todos a una, porque cuando estamos juntos, somos muy buenos, somos mejores. P. Dijo usted hace unos días que son un equipo joven y que los veteranos deben ser un ejemplo. R. Hay que darlo y demostrarlo. No es tanto hablar. A veces uno mira y dice: “Uf, Aubameyang tiene 37 años y cómo entrena, va al gimnasio. Lo que fue, lo que es”. Y lo siguen. Al ser veteranos y tener ya unas cuantas batallas a la espalda, una palabra nuestra le llega a un compañero, sobre todo cuando no lo está pasando bien. Ahí es cuando tenemos que entrar, levantarlos y no dejarlos caer. P. ¿Habló con Leo Román? R. Ese es un ejemplo. Leo es un chico que todavía está creciendo, que sigue aprendiendo y al que todas esas cosas le van a potenciar para su futuro. Se va a aferrar a lo que hizo para mejorarlo. Pero me quedo con la personalidad que tiene, porque en el segundo tiempo pasó lo que pasó y quiso seguir jugando. Eso es saber revertir la situación por la que pasó, que fue cometer un error, pero no sólo de él. Que él haya entregado la pelota así no significa que haya sido el fallo sólo suyo. El error fue de todo el equipo porque en los movimientos que hizo en la cancha no le dio la posibilidad de tener un pase fácil. ¿Me explico? El fútbol es de errores. Entonces, ahí es donde nosotros tenemos que aparecer. Es donde yo me siento responsable de ir y decirle a Leo: “Vos no tienes que bajar los brazos. Al contrario, motívate con esta situación para hacer las cosas mejor”. P. Hablemos de las diferencias entre Simeone y Antonio Hidalgo. R. Son dos entrenadores que quieren ganar. Los veo muy parecidos, las comparaciones son odiosas, te lo juro, y no me gusta hacerlas. Pero en este caso las voy a hacer, porque es algo que se ve y lo noto. Antonio es un obsesionado por el trabajo, por querer corregir y mejorar y tratar de darnos herramientas para poder ser mejores en la cancha, mejorar como equipo, mejorar defensivamente, que eso es algo que ya lo había visto en el Cholo. Hablando de comparaciones, los veo a los dos con esa ambición, con esas ganas, y si no ganan, están fastidiados. P. ¿Cómo cambia el chip un jugador que pasa de jugar la Champions a militar en un club recién ascendido? R. Se maneja desde el trabajo. Es cierto que Aubameyang y yo venimos de la Champions, pero estamos aquí para ser uno más en la plantilla, para intentar ser un líder y ayudar. En el Atlético era capitán y tenía una responsabilidad y un peso que asumía con mucho compromiso para liderar a un equipo que, con la ayuda de los demás compañeros, estaba compitiendo la Champions y nos tocó jugar la final de la Copa del Rey el año pasado. Son palabras mayores. Aquí en el Dépor me decían mis amigos: “Vas a bajar al barro”. Pero yo no lo siento así, yo lo sentí como un desafío hermoso para mí y para mi familia, para poder ayudar y competir con toda la ilusión del mundo. Estoy feliz. Desde el fondo de mi corazón, no me arrepiento de haber venido y estoy agradecido a lo que me hiciera tomar la decisión, porque cuanto más tiempo pasa más me doy cuenta de que no me equivoqué, de que hice lo correcto. P. ¿Cómo es José María Giménez en casa? R. Complicado [se ríe]. Antes seguía pensando en fútbol y no desconectaba. Me costó mucho hacerlo, pero al final sí lo logré. Soy un tipo al que le costó disfrutar en casa. Pero ahora lo hago. Y hoy por hoy, cuando llego, soy otra persona y trato de disfrutar de la vida. Intento salir a caminar por la playa, jugar al ping-pong con mi hijo, jugar al ajedrez con el otro, ir al parque con el chiquito, llevar al entrenamiento al grande... Tengo una vida de padre. Ayudo a mi esposa, que es una compañera magnífica y que está ahí siempre. Cuando le dije que íbamos al Deportivo, aceptó, una fenómena. Estoy agradecido eternamente, no solo por los hijos maravillosos que me dio, sino por lo que es el día a día que disfrutamos. P. ¿Ya no ve fútbol por la tele? R. La verdad es que estoy tan contento en A Coruña que no me da tiempo para pensar en el fútbol, no miro fútbol ya. Imagínate, el otro día había partidos preciosos para ver y me fui a cenar con mi mujer. Antes llegaba a casa y seguía pensando en fútbol, veía partidos… Ahora pienso en ir a casa y en descansar. Desconecto. Bueno, cuando no tengo que estudiar, claro… Hoy por ejemplo tengo clases por la noche. P. ¿Algún curso relacionado con el fútbol? R. No, no. Estoy terminando el bachillerato. Lo estoy haciendo online, me quedan apenas cuatro semanas y recibiré el título de bachiller, por suerte. P. En A Coruña está pudiendo disfrutar de dos hobbies: la pesca y la cocina… R. Me encanta pescar, más que jugar al fútbol [se ríe] y cocinar, también. Si no fuese futbolista, me hubiese gustado ser cocinero, chef. Me gusta mucho la cocina. P. ¿Una especialidad? R. Bueno, el asado. Pero a mí me gusta mucho, ¿sabes qué? Hacer cocina de olla. Al fuego, pero al fuego de leña. Como los callos madrileños, pero no los de Galicia. Aquí son diferentes. Me gusta todo tipo de comida de cuchara y se me da bien cocinarla. .

articles.title: Una ‘conjura’ para recuperar a Lookman
articles.standfirst: Cuerpo técnico y vestuario miman al extremo en busca de la versión de su llegada al Atlético
articles.summary: Cuerpo técnico y vestuario miman al extremo en busca de la versión de su llegada al Atlético
articles.body: Pese a que en julio apareció por San Rafael luciendo un tono que evidenciaba un cuidado extremo durante sus vacaciones y a que despachó una ilusionante pretemporada que permitía albergar la esperanza incluso de que podría mejorar sus estelares cinco primeros meses como rojiblanco, nada más lejos de la realidad: Lookman es una sombra de lo que fue, se ha salido del foco (también de los onces) y ha tocado fondo. Sin embargo, ni el cuerpo técnico ni el vestuario le pierde la fe. Todo lo contrario: nadie duda de su capacidad ni se pone en entredicho su actitud, de ahí que exista una causa común por recuperarlo deportiva, y sobre todo, anímicamente ante su importancia para el equipo. Tras empezar el curso como titular e incluso marcar en el Pizjuán en el tiempo en que se vio obligado a reciclarse en delantero por la lesión de Sorloth, el culebrón que retrasó la normal actividad de Julián y la falta de otro 9 hasta que llegó Jonathan David, curiosamente ha sido con el regreso a su posición natural cuando Lookman ha empezado a perder brillo. Pese a intentarlo una y otra vez, su desborde comenzó a desaparecer, encadenando actuaciones sin lograr irse nunca de su par. Un declive que culminó ante el Bayern desentendiéndose de Laimer en la acción del 0-2 y que puso de manifiesto que no atraviesa por su mejor momento. De ahí que la respuesta en el Cerro no se haya hecho esperar: mimos y confianza para que regrese el torbellino que marcó y dio una asistencia en el 4-0 de Copa al Barça del curso pasado y que también firmó el gol que tumbó a los de Flick en el camino a las semifinales de Champions.

articles.title: La paradoja de Hugo Duro ante el Real Madrid
articles.standfirst: El equipo blanco es la víctima favorita del delantero del Valencia que apunta a la suplencia por segundo partido consecutivo
articles.summary: El equipo blanco es la víctima favorita del delantero del Valencia que apunta a la suplencia por segundo partido consecutivo
articles.body: Ningún rival ha sufrido tanto a Hugo Duro en LaLiga como el Real Madrid: cinco goles en diez enfrentamientos, los mismos que le ha marcado al Atlético. Pero el delantero del Valencia llega a la cita ante el conjunto blanco en el peor momento posible. No tiene el gol de su lado y su sitio en el once lo ocupa otro. Umar Sadiq, que marcó en el último partido contra el Elche, saldrá de inicio. El especialista en tumbar al Madrid esperará su turno en el banquillo. En apenas una semana ha cambiado el orden en el ataque valencianista, sobre todo por la recuperación del delantero nigeriano y su oportunismo y buen rendimiento nada más regresar. Ante el Elche, Duro no jugó ni un minuto, algo casi insólito en su etapa en el club. Desde que fichó por el Valencia en la temporada 2022-23, después de un curso cedido en Mestalla por el Getafe, solo se había quedado en el banquillo sin jugar en seis partidos. El del Elche fue el séptimo. Porque el problema no es de insistencia, sino de puntería. Hugo Duro es el delantero de LaLiga que más remates acumula sin que ninguno vaya entre los tres palos: diez disparos y ninguno a portería. Además, atraviesa su racha más larga sin marcar en la competición, 11 partidos, desde la que encadenó hasta agosto de 2023 (29 encuentros). Es una mala racha que pesa en un futbolista que siempre ha vivido del área y de la fe en la siguiente ocasión. Javier Aguirre ha querido quitar hierro al asunto antes de que la suplencia se convierta en un caso. El técnico ya se ha sentado con el delantero: “Ya tuve una conversación con él. Se encuentra bien, lo corroboro. Lo vi bien anímicamente”, explica. Y deja la puerta abierta a que vuelva en cualquier momento: “Es un jugador nuestro y hay que utilizar a todos. Tenemos que estar todos con ganas de jugar. Está ahí”, zanja. Ahí es en el banquillo, pendiente de los minutos que le lleguen, y frente al adversario que mejor conoce. Sadiq tiene ahora el crédito del último gol. Duro tiene la estadística a su favor ante el Madrid, que en otras ocasiones le ha servido para salir del bache. Al delantero podría bastarle con un remate a puerta, el primero de la temporada, para darle la vuelta a este momento. Pero primero tiene que convencer al entrenador de que lo ponga.

articles.summary: El argentino, en pleno proceso de recuperar la confianza de la hinchada, se enfrentará al Barça... el mejor día para la redención definitiva
articles.body: Llegó el Día J. Llegó el primer enfrentamiento del Atlético con el Barça... con Julián de rojiblanco. Llegó el día en el que la Araña se enfrentará a los ‘fantasmas’ de su pasado reciente, aquellos que le empujaron a sacar del armario quien ya no está cerca de él. Sin obviar su responsabilidad, que la tiene, el 19 va dando los pasos hacia el camino correcto: despejar la mente, limpiar su entorno y centrarse en lo que mejor sabe hacer: ser uno de los mejores delanteros del mundo. Pidió perdón en el momento justo, rebajando los decibilios de una grada que parece en el camino del perdón. Seguirá costando, pero la redención definitiva bien podría llegar mañana, marcando al equipo que le metió en la cabeza (suculentas comisiones aparte) que su lugar en el mundo no es el Atlético de Madrid. Y lo es. Y lo será hasta 2030. Y volverá a ser el de los picotazos de las grandes noches. El que seguro se arrepiente de todo lo vivido desde mayo a septiembre. El que rechazó al PSG por jugar a las órdenes de Simeone en 2024. El que debe ser el líder de un proyecto que depende en buena parte de que regrese a lo grande.

articles.title: FA Cup: Altrincham look for latest giant-killing against Notts County
articles.summary: Non-league Altrincham aim to make Notts County number 18 on their list of FA Cup scalps, and breathe new life into their tag of English football's ultimate giant-killers.
articles.body:
"I honestly believe that we were the best non-league team ever. Look at that history - it should give the players the confidence that anything is possible."

With more than 500 appearances for Altrincham during its golden era of the '70s and '80s, Graham Heathcote knows all about the club's remarkable relationship with the FA Cup, and the giant-killing exploits that forged its identity.

One of the club's most legendary figures, he believes they can inspire the current team to pull off another upset against League One Notts County, despite being separated by two divisions.

Over the years, Altrincham - currently seventh in the National League - have defeated 17 Football League opponents in the competition, more than any other club that has spent its entire existence in non-league football.

During a 14-year playing career at the club, Heathcote secured a crucial part of that history. A 100-goal midfielder in an Altrincham team that despite being part-time, managed to reach the FA Cup's third round in four consecutive seasons between 1978 and 1982.

"It was an unbelievable achievement because in those days you didn't get weakened sides in the competition like you do now with the bigger clubs," Heathcote told BBC Sport.

Now in his 70s, and still living in Altrincham, he added: "During that period, we actually had a better FA Cup record than any side in the old third and fourth divisions."

Heathcote was at the heart of some of the club's most memorable achievements, twice helping the fifth-tier side to defy the odds with third-round draws against first division opponents; Everton at Goodison Park in 1975, and then a star-studded Spurs at White Hart Lane in 1979.

An office worker at Salford docks at the time, Heathcote even scored a penalty in front of the Kop at Anfield against Liverpool in the third round in 1981. This was an era in which Altrincham also won the FA Trophy twice. So what was their secret in cups?

"We had this determination, and we became feared at that time," he says. "You reach your level in football, but on a one-off occasion you'd be astonished at where you can raise your game to. You can't do it every week, but it's just a case of getting the mindset right on the day."

The club may also have been fuelled by a sense of injustice. Because despite twice winning what was then the Alliance Premier League, Altrincham were victims of a ballot system that cruelly denied them progression to the Football League - by just a single vote in 1980 - before automatic promotion was introduced a few years later.

Heathcote had left by the time Altrincham pulled off their greatest cup exploit - knocking out first division Birmingham City at St Andrews in 1986 in what remains one of the competition's biggest shocks. They became only the second of four non-league teams to beat top-flight opposition away from home.

Forty years on from that famous night, current manager Neil Gibson is all too aware of the tradition that he now hopes to continue in front of a live BBC TV audience, and a bumper Moss Lane crowd.

Having joined last year to help the club avoid relegation, the Welshman has overseen an impressive start to the current National League campaign, with Altrincham looking like play-off contenders. The dream of a first ever promotion to the EFL is the priority. But Gibson is desperate to build on the recent progress against Notts County.

"It would mean a lot. It's the spirit and essence of this club," he says. "We have a real opportunity. They are a very good team, but it's a game where we feel that we can go and etch our own memories. All the fans remember those cup moments from the past and we want to try and replicate that."

Situated just a few miles from Old Trafford, and in an area of Greater Manchester dominated by fans of United and City, Altrincham has to work hard to maintain its supporter base. But this is a rare moment in the national spotlight for a community club that only turned professional four years ago.

"A lot of our players are good enough to play at a higher level, and it's a chance to showcase themselves and test ourselves against a club that three years ago were in the same league as us," says Gibson, whose squad includes five players that have previously appeared for Notts County.

Gibson has real cup pedigree of his own to draw upon, including against Saturday's opponents. 24 years ago, he played for Conference club Southport as they produced a memorable FA Cup upset over Notts County. He was part of the Tranmere squad that reached the League Cup final in 2000, and he also won the Welsh Cup three times, including twice as a manager.

"Cups have always been very special to me," he says. "We're really excited about it and we're going to give it absolutely everything. But you only remember these days if you come out on the right side of the result."

Watch live on BBC Two and iPlayer from 17:15 BST, with live text commentary on the BBC Sport website and app.

As for Heathcote, he also managed Altrincham - between 2002 and 2009. And in a remarkable twist of fate, his special connection with the competition has been carried on by his son.

Not content with emulating his father by also playing for Altrincham, Sam Heathcote then helped them to beat League One Barnsley in 2015, the club's most recent cup upset.

And as if that was not enough, having joined local rivals Macclesfield, this year Sam was at the heart of the defence for the National League North side as they stunned then-holders Crystal Palace to produce the greatest shock in FA Cup history, with a staggering 117 places between the sides.

"That far exceeded anything I've done," says Graham, when asked how he explains the Heathcotes' record in the cup across the generations. "I never won in the third round. It's just one of those things!"

Heathcote senior will be at League One side Mansfield on Saturday where he hopes to watch Sam - who works as a teacher in Altrincham - pull off another upset for Macclesfield. But he will also be paying close attention to the action at Moss Lane, and is backing his former club to taste glory once again.

"I'd love to see them get to the third round, so the current generation of Altrincham fans can feel what it's all about," he says. "51 years ago I played at Everton and people still speak about it now. These players have that chance to create such a legacy. Don't just dream about it. Make it happen."

Altrincham's challenge now is to follow in his footsteps, make Notts County number 18 on their long list of scalps, and breathe new life into their reputation as non-league football's ultimate giant-killers.

articles.title: "Un multihomenaje para la eternidad"
articles.standfirst: 'Comprimidos', por Juan Ignacio Gallardo - Director de MARCA
articles.summary: 'Comprimidos', por Juan Ignacio Gallardo - Director de MARCA
articles.body: Con una intención que rebosaba solidaridad, AFE solicitó que no se disputara esta jornada. Pero suspender los partidos, parar el fútbol, no era necesariamente la mejor manera de rendir homenaje a Jesús de Miguel. La consternación y el dolor que todos sentimos con esta pérdida irreparable no encontraría mayor consuelo si las gradas estuvieran vacías este fin de semana. Claro que la opinión de quienes defendían esta alternativa de la suspensión es muy respetable y entendible, pero el hecho de que miles y miles de aficionados en todos los estadios de España puedan recordar a ‘Demi’ hoy y mañana anticipa una jornada absolutamente emotiva. La RFEF y LaLiga, y todos los estamentos futbolísticos, han dado muestras de sensibilidad absoluta en esta excepcional situación. Primero, suspendiendo de forma inmediata los encuentros de la Copa del Rey y de la Reina; después, concediendo con celeridad el lógico aplazamiento de los partidos de los equipos directamente afectados, Tenerife y Andorra; y por último, estudiando detenidamente, con respeto y prudencia, la decisión a tomar acerca de esta jornada. Desgraciadamente, nada nos podrá devolver ya a Jesús de Miguel, pero como titulábamos en nuestra portada, queremos recordarle celebrando goles. Y así le tiene que rememorar la gran familia del fútbol, reunida en torno a los partidos que se van a disputar este fin de semana y dedicando esta jornada a su memoria. Seguro que las muestras de cariño hacia su figura serán numerosas. Las fijadas con acertado criterio por LaLiga y la RFEF (como el parón en el minuto 9, el de su dorsal) y las que surjan de manera espontanea en cada campo. La suma de todos estos homenajes, a buen seguro cálidos, conmovedores y abrumadores (como la preciosa decisión de Las Palmas de jugar con los colores del Tenerife) no se producirían si las gradas hubieran estado vacías, frías y silenciosas este sábado y este domingo. Jugar al fútbol es una hermosa forma de honrar la memoria de un futbolista. Descansa en paz, ‘Demi’. § Me da la sensación de que el ‘fichaje’ de Rafa Nadal, como flamante nuevo directivo del Real Madrid, va a frenar el proyecto de Florentino de privatizar el club. § Gerardo Riquelme lo advierte: imagina que los hackers que hicieron subir la temperatura de las neveras de decenas de supermercados de Centroeuropa, estropeando todos los productos, hicieran lo mismo en los centros donde se guardan las muestras antidopaje... § La lista de De la Fuente nos trae tres novedades (Jacobo Ramón, Valles y Marc Roca) y reabre el apetito de ver de nuevo a la selección tras el ‘parón’ por la Liga. § ¿Bengals o Falcons? ¿Usted quién quiere que gane?

articles.title: James Trafford: England goalkeeper says not playing for Manchester City was 'horrendous'
articles.summary: James Trafford says not playing for Manchester City last season was "horrendous" and left him with no choice but to leave the club and join Leeds United in the summer.
articles.body:
James Trafford says not playing for Manchester City last season was "horrendous" before he moved to Leeds United in the summer in search of first-team football.

City re-signed academy graduate Trafford in July 2025, two years after he had left the club to join Championship side Burnley.

But less than six weeks after his arrival, Italy international Gianluigi Donnarumma arrived from Paris St-Germain.

The 27-year-old, who helped the French club win the Champions League just weeks earlier, immediately became City's first-choice goalkeeper, leaving Trafford short of playing time.

After starting the first three matches of the campaign, 24-year-old Trafford made just one further Premier League start in the 35 games that followed Donnarumma's arrival.

Speaking on Football Daily's The Football Interview, Trafford reflected on the difficulties he encountered during a season on the fringes of Pep Guardiola's squad.

"What a horrendous, horrendous feeling. Not playing," said Trafford.

"You are ringing a lot of people and just venting. Like most people, you have a [bad] day at work and you ring someone up.

"I ring my dad, I ring my mum, I ring my missus, I ring my mates. I like ringing my mates and we can just have a good talk about it all. It's quite funny."

Despite his limited playing time, Trafford believes he still gained plenty from his final season at City, having helped the club win the League Cup and FA Cup after starting both finals at Wembley.

"Going into any season, I always have the highest of hopes and always the belief that it will go the best way it could," he added.

"Unfortunately, we didn't win all four trophies. It didn't go how I expected it to go, but it happens.

"In the moment, I just tried to make the best of it as I could. Looking back, I don't think it was a disappointing season in the end because I learned so much, I improved so much and I won two trophies in one year.

"There were moments when I was very down, regretting things and feeling disappointed, but looking back, I'm very thankful for the experience. What an incredible year."

'It's my aim to be England's number one'

Trafford was part of England's squad for the 2026 World Cup and, although he did not get game time, being part of Thomas Tuchel's squad was an "incredible experience" that he says he will not forget.

"I didn't play, but it is what it is," said Trafford. "I didn't expect to play when I got called up. I knew what my role was, but you just take as much experience as possible, learn from it and keep trying to win the day, because the more days you win, the better position you're in."

Next time around, though, Trafford hopes to be England's starting goalkeeper and believes that if he continues his impressive performances with Leeds , that ambition is entirely achievable.

"It's my aim and it's something I've always dreamed of," said Trafford.

"I always believe that one day I could be. Every day I try to keep improving to put myself in the best position to be England's number one one day.

"I think everyone in the goalkeeping department with the national team wants to be number one because it's an amazing position to be in."

'Leeds would love to get back into Europe'

After returning from the World Cup, Trafford left City to join Leeds United in a deal worth up to £45m - a record for a British goalkeeper.

Since arriving at Elland Road, he has relished the opportunity to play regularly in the Premier League.

The former Bolton Wanderers and Accrington Stanley loanee has started all nine of Leeds ' Premier League matches this season, keeping three clean sheets, with only Brighton (seven) and Arsenal (five) having conceded fewer goals than Daniel Farke's side (eight).

His performances have helped Leeds to 12th in the table before this weekend's fixtures - just two points off the European places - and he says the club are only going to get better.

"I just think it's an incredible club," he said. "You look at the fanbase, everyone here - it's an incredible place. It's just somewhere that's only going and getting better.

"We'd love to get back into Europe. I think every club you ask would like to get into Europe, so the main goal is just to keep on improving."

articles.title: How will Barcelona line up against Atlético Madrid?
articles.summary: Hansi Flick’s possible XI for Sunday’s clash
articles.body:
Barcelona look to go into the final international break of the season with a statement win in the bag as the La Liga leaders travel to the capital for a monster top of the table clash against Atlético Madrid at the Metropolitano .

Here's how we think Hansi Flick will line up his troops for Sunday's battle:

Barça are expecting to have an almost fully healthy and fit squad after the break if there are no issues during the international window, and they will also have Eric Garcia and Andreas Christensen in the squad for Sunday.

But the two defenders have not trained long enough to be ready to start, so we expect the same back four in front of Joan Garcia that kept a clean sheet against Aston Villa: Pau Cubarsí and Gerard Martín at center-back, João Cancelo at left-back, and Brian Fariñas , who continues to impress since getting his first opportunity last weekend, starting at right-back.

Barça will be without Rodri with a minor hamstring issue and there's a real doubt about who will Flick choose to partner Pedri and Fermín López .

Marc Bernal had a strong substitute cameo as Rodri's replacement in midweek and has been Flick's first backup choice to the Spain captain so far this season, but Frenkie de Jong is back to 100% and ready to step back into his favorite midfield role.

We think Flick will go with the Dutchman for this one, which will likely cause a slight change of formation with a double pivot of Frenkie and Pedri and Fermín as the number 10.

Lamine Yamal and Raphinha shined against Villa and will be looking for another big night against Atlético's tough defense, and we think Flick will once again trust Anthony Gordon ahead of Karim Adeyemi for this one.

Possible XI : Joan; Fariñas, Cubarsí, Martín, Cancelo; De Jong, Pedri; Yamal, Fermín, Gordon; Raphinha (4-2-3-1)

articles.title: TSG Hoffenheim vs. Schalke 04 preview: Underachievers clash in last game before international break
articles.summary: Schalke will hope to end their abysmal run before the international break as they face fellow strugglers Hoffenheim away from home.HoffenheimAfter three away...
articles.body:
Schalke will hope to end their abysmal run before the international break as they face fellow strugglers Hoffenheim away from home.

After three away games in a week, Christian Ilzer's men will be back at SNP Arena on Sunday night. The Sinsheim side failed to win those fixtures in three different competitions. The defeat in Bremen ended a two-game winning streak in Bundesliga, days after they were knocked out of the DFB-Pokal by 2. Bundesliga outfit Holstein Kiel.

And, on Thursday, they were very close to upset Europa Conference League winners Crystal Palace before an injury-time strike by former Eintracht Frankfurt midfielder Daichi Kamada undone them. However, Hoffenheim won their last two home games 3-0 against Lyon and Bayer Leverkusen.

Adam Hložek and Vladimir Coufal weren't in the traveling squad in London, but they both could make their return on Sunday. Alexander Prass, who scored Hoffenheim's goal against Palace, will be back after missing last week's defeat to Bremen due to suspension.

Since the return of club football from October's international break, Schalke 04 have only picked up a single point in the Bundesliga. Miron Muslić's men were also knocked out of the cup by 2. Bundesliga club Dynamo Dresden as they only scored one goal in their last six competitive games.

On matchday 8, Schalke's search for a first home goal was unsuccessful as they were dominated from start to finish by RB Leipzig, who lost all their previous away matches until that point. Schalke's next two games at Veltins Arena will also be against Champions League participants VfB Stuttgart and Borussia Dortmund.

Soufiane El-Faouzi and Robin Gosens returned to training weeks after their head collision in the goalless draw with Köln. As it usually happens with out-of-form clubs, Muslić will be expected to once again make multiple changes to his starting lineup.

Hoffenheim were victorious in each of the last four meetings with Schalke, who returned to top-flight football this term. Klaas-Jan Huntelaar, Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting and Leroy Sane were on target when the Royal Blues last won at Hoffenheim nearly a decade ago.

articles.title: Aleksandar Pavlović wants to win everything with Bayern Munich
articles.summary: The star midfielder thinks FC Bayern can win multiple trophies in the coming years.
articles.body:
Aleksandar Pavlović is not interested in setting modest targets for Bayern Munich this season. The young midfielder has made it clear that the expectations inside the dressing room are as high as ever, with the club aiming to compete for every major trophy available.

Asked about Bayern's objectives for the campaign, Pavlović delivered a straightforward answer that should sound familiar to anyone who understands the expectations at the Allianz Arena

"We want to win everything: the Champions League, the DFB-Pokal and the Bundesliga title," Pavlović told Sport Bild's Christian Falk and Julian Agardi (as captured by @iMiaSanMia ).

There is no shortage of ambition in those words, but Bayern Munich has the squad and quality to make those aspirations realistic. The Bundesliga remains the club's domestic priority, and Vincent Kompany will expect his team to maintain its consistency over the course of a demanding league campaign. Bayern also has unfinished business in the DFB-Pokal, a competition they have not won since 2020. Ending that drought would be another important milestone for this group.

Then there is the Champions League, the ultimate measuring stick for any Bayern Munich side. Winning the competition requires more than individual brilliance. It demands consistency, resilience, tactical discipline, and the ability to deliver when the pressure is at its highest.

For Pavlović, these are not simply lofty aspirations. They are the standards expected at Bayern Munich. The midfielder has grown into an increasingly important part of the squad, and his mentality reflects the club's ambitions.

Winning one trophy would represent a successful season for many clubs. At Bayern, the expectation is to chase all three. Pavlović clearly understands that distinction. Now the hard part begins: turning those words into silverware.

articles.title: Nico Paz: Como director spills the beans on Man United target’s future amid Real Madrid speculation
articles.summary: Manchester United are laying down succession plans for their mercurial skipper Bruno Fernandes. The Portuguese’s spectacular 2025/26 campaign, during which h...
articles.body:
Manchester United are laying down succession plans for their mercurial skipper Bruno Fernandes . The Portuguese's spectacular 2025/26 campaign, during which he registered a record 21 assists in the Premier League, helped the Red Devils finish third in the league.

If supporters expected the 32-year-old to continue his golden run this campaign, they have been left disappointed. Fernandes has managed five goals and just two assists in 13 games across all competitions to date, and United are subsequently 17th in the league table after nine games.

It is clear that the English giants are heavily reliant on their talisman, and every time he struggles, the team hits an off note as well. With Fernandes also in the final 12 months of his contract, it is imperative that United bring in an able heir soon.

Recent reports suggest that they have found a candidate in Como starlet Nico Paz .

Paz has been a revelation since leaving Real Madrid to join Como in the summer of 2024. Last season, the 22-year-old registered 13 goals and eight assists in 40 games across all competitions.

This campaign, the Argentine has hit a higher gear, and has already amassed six goals and eight assists in 13 appearances. United got a first-hand account of the player's capabilities when he single-handedly destroyed them in the Champions League last week.

Paz scored two goals and set up one more as Cesc Fabregas' side secured a 4-1 win at home. The Argentine's performance has reportedly convinced the Red Devils, but Los Blancos are looming large amid speculation of a buy-back clause.

Como sporting director Carlalberto Ludi has now provided an update on the player's future.

Speaking to Radio Radio, as cited by Tuttomercatoweb , Ludi insisted that he feels sorry for Como fans because they have to deal with transfer rumours every year. He said: "I put myself in the shoes of Como's supporters, because every November and every March – whether due to media speculation or for other reasons – it always comes up that Real Madrid are taking all their players back home."

"This year the talk is of Jacobo Ramon and, over the next two seasons, of Nico Paz."

The Italian club's sporting director acknowledged Los Blancos' buy-back clause in Paz's deal, but hinted that any potential sale would be on Como's terms. He continued: "The truth is that we struck a good deal last summer. Nico Paz is 100 per cent a Como player. Real Madrid have retained a buy-back option until a specific date during the transfer window, as is to be expected."

"It would, however, be a sale that would recognise the value of our work and would also be important for the club. We'll work out how to manage the situation during the season, as we've always done over the years, thanks in part to the fantastic relationship we have with Madrid."

"For now, we must enjoy having him in our squad, because he really is an incredible star player."

The comments further suggest that prising the Argentine away from the Stadio Giuseppe Sinigaglia will not be easy. However, United must acknowledge that replacing Fernandes will come at a price and a move for Paz, even though initially costly, could end up becoming a masterstroke.

articles.title: Max Eberl would love to bring £50m player to Bayern Munich
articles.summary: Bayern Munich are expected to sign a new winger, either in the January window or next summer, and several names have been linked with a move already. One of...
articles.body:
Bayern Munich are expected to sign a new winger, either in the January window or next summer, and several names have been linked with a move already.

One of the players who is of interest to Bayern is Antonio Nusa, who has impressed heavily at RB Leipzig in the past 15 months.

Bayern were heavily linked with a move for JJ Gabriel of Manchester United , but the youngster has decided to join Real Madrid instead.

Bayern Munich interested in Antonio Nusa?

Christian Falk has exclusively told CFBayern Insider that Bayern had shown interest in Nusa during the summer window.

Max Eberl really likes the player and would love to bring him to Bayern.

The Bavarian giants are looking for a back-up for Luis Diaz in the left-wing role, but Nusa would provide direct competition to the Colombian.

Falk said: " It is TRUE: Antonio Nusa was on Bayern's radar in the summer.Max Eberl loves this player and would really like to bring him to Bayern Munich. As I mentioned, Bayern were looking for a potential backup option to Luis Diaz, but Nusa is no "backup". He wants frequent game time in the starting XI. Also, it's worth noting that RB Leipzig paid €21m [£17.5m] for the Norway international; great business it has to be said. However, if Bayern Munich are at the table, €21m will not be enough. I heard that there were talks in the range of €50m-60m [£41.6m-50m].

"This would have been too much for a backup signing. So, I don't think there's a chance to bring Nusa to Munich next summer but in the end you have to see what happens with the other players. We've mentioned players who are two or three years younger and can develop. But if it doesn't work out, like with JJ Gabriel, perhaps Nusa can come up in conversation again. Of course, negotiations between RB Leipzig are Bayern Munich typically difficult and expensive! So, I'm not sure if it will work. "

Antonio Nusa would be a fantastic signing

(Photo by Alexander Hassenstein/Getty Images)

The 21-year-old joined RB Leipzig in the summer of 2024, and has made 85 appearances for the club, scoring 16 goals across all competitions.

Usually, he plays on the left, but can also play on the right and through the middle, and his versatility could be an asset for Vincent Kompany.

Nusa has a contract at Leipzig until 2029, and Falk has suggested that it will not be easy for Bayern to negotiate deals in their favour with their Bundesliga rivals.

articles.title: Mika Baur on the demands of playing for Celtic
articles.summary: Mika Baur is slowly but surely getting used to the incredible demands of playing for Celtic. The German international spoke after his best performance so far...
articles.body:
Mika Baur is slowly but surely getting used to the incredible demands of playing for Celtic. The German international spoke after his best performance so far on Thursday night's victory over Besiktas in the Europa League…

Mika Baur of Celtic passes the ball during the UEFA Europa League match between Celtic FC and Besiktas JK at Celtic Park on November 05, 2026. (Photo by Zak Mauger/Getty Images)

The German international has spoke of the demands of playing three times a week, but is adamant he's enjoying the hectic schedule.

Baur getting used to Celtic's intense playing schedule

"To play every three days is different for me," the midfielder said, to the mainstream media after Celtic's 3-2 victory over Besiktas in the Europa League on Thursday evening. "I think I have played the same amount of games now that I had last season by the winter break.

Mika Baur of Celtic during the UEFA Europa League 2026/27 League Phase MD3 match between Celtic FC and Real Club Celta Vigo at Celtic Park on October 22, 2026. (Photo by Ian MacNicol/Getty Images)

"But I like it. That's what you want. You want to play all the time, more playing than training. I am really enjoying it. And I think the pressure to win is a good kind of pressure. It's better than (trying) not to lose. So I really enjoy it," Baur stated, as reported by Scottish Sun.

"First of all, I want to work hard for the team, for myself, that I can prove myself and I can play on the stage, help the team, put in a shift, hard work," he said.

Baur impressed once again in the 3-2 Europa League win over Besiktas , and not just due to his skill and technical ability but his overall pressing and battling attributes as the hoops fought to a hard earned win.

"I was really happy that it was appreciated," Mika Baur

Mika Baur of Celtic is crowded out by Dundee United players Celtic v Dundee United, Scottish Premiership, Celtic Park, 28 October 2026. Mark Runnacles IMAGO Shutterstock

He added: "That's what I have to do first. And then after this, the skill comes, playing with the ball. But first of all, it's showing heart on the field. I was really happy that it was appreciated.

"The second half was pure heart, pure fight," Baur said. "I'm not here for a long time, but I think that's what it's all about. This win feels unbelievable because we deserved it. We fought for it.

"The team is really, really close together. We know that we had a tough couple of weeks, but you can feel it in the training sessions, how the team is working together, the feeling, the believing is always there.

Baur acknowledges the Celtic support – "They gave us a lot of energy"

"And it was there on the pitch. That's what we have to show week by week, every three days.

"It was not just our win. The atmosphere was great. I'm really, really thankful for every supporter in the stadium. They gave us a lot of energy. We all fight together. That makes me happy."

Callum McGregor of Celtic applauds the fans with teammates after the UEFA Europa League match between Celtic FC and Besiktas JK at Celtic Park on November 05, 2026. (Photo by Ian MacNicol/Getty Images)

It certainly was a memorable night at Celtic Park and a notable victory against a decent Turkish outfit that probably thought that the points were there for the taking after Celtic's earlier turmoils in European football this season.

Next two Europa League matches are winnable and Celtic need to get maximum points

Celtic has four remaining matches in the Europa League and probably will be looking for another nine points to guarantee qualification, although seven may be enough.

The next two matches, away to Portuguese minnows Torreense on 26 November and Omonia Nicosia on 10 December will be matches that Martin O'Neill will be looking for six points to take Celtic in to the two January fixtures still in with a shout.

articles.title: ‘Some legends don't say goodbye’: Ex-India cricketer's heartfelt message for Mohammed Shami after Test retirement
articles.summary: Mohammed Shami has officially announced his retirement from Test cricket, marking the end of a distinguished twelve-year journey. Over his career, he partici...
articles.body:
Former India cricketer and ex-Bengal captain Manoj Tiwary paid an emotional tribute to Mohammed Shami after the veteran fast bowler announced his retirement from Test cricket on Friday, bringing the curtain down on a 12-year career in the longest format. Tiwary, who had the opportunity to lead Bengal with Shami in his bowling attack, took to X to reflect on the pacer's impact and recall his association with the speedster. He described Shami as a warrior, while also highlighting the lasting memories he had created through his performances in the red-ball format. "The red ball may no longer be in his hands, but the memories of his thunderbolts will forever remain in the hearts of cricket lovers. Some legends don't say goodbye; they simply become history," Tiwary wrote.

Recalling his time as Bengal captain, he added: "This what it meant to me When I was leading the bengal team and having Shami in the bowling line up. Warrior at heart" Shami's announcement brings an end to an impressive Test career spanning 64 matches, during which he picked up 229 wickets. The 36-year-old made the announcement through an Instagram post, confirming that while he would no longer represent India in the white jersey, he intended to continue playing white-ball cricket. "I am leaving the white jersey, but never the memories connected to it. When I first wore India's Test jersey, I had only a dream — to do something for my country. After that every wicket, every struggle, every injury and every comeback taught me something," Shami wrote. "Test cricket is not just a format for me, it is a very special part of my life. Today I am deciding to retire from Test cricket with a heavy heart and unlimited beautiful memories," he added.

A 12-year journey in India's Test colours

Shami made his Test debut against the West Indies at Kolkata's Eden Gardens on November 6, 2013. He ended his career with 229 wickets at an average of 27.71, including six five-wicket hauls. His ability to extract movement through seam and swing with both the new and old ball made him a crucial member of India's pace attack across different conditions. Of his 229 wickets, 131 came in 35 Tests played in South Africa, the West Indies and India, where he maintained an average of under 25. South Africa witnessed some of Shami's finest performances in Test cricket. During India's 2018 tour, he produced a match-winning spell of 5/28 in the second innings of the Johannesburg Test, helping the visitors secure a consolation victory. On India's subsequent visit to the country, he continued his impressive record by claiming eight wickets in the series-opening Test at Centurion. Shami's final appearance in Test cricket came in the 2023 World Test Championship final against Australia at Lord's. Injuries later disrupted his career, and he remained out of the Indian team after the 2025 Champions Trophy, before deciding to bring his red-ball journey to a close.
